tutorial.title: How to Play Hubzi?
tutorial.s1_d: At the bottom you have cards with key concepts extracted from your material. Click one or drag it to prepare it.
tutorial.s1_tip: Each card represents a definition or key principle.
tutorial.s2_d: The nodes on the board give you challenges. Click the matching node to place the correct card.
tutorial.s2_tip: If you have doubts, Hubzi can give you hints in real time.
tutorial.s3_d: Answer the validation question to seal the concept. Beat the 5 progressive levels and master any subject!
tutorial.s3_tip: You can talk to Hubzi anytime by tapping her microphone.

legal.title: Legal & Transparency Center
legal.subtitle: Hubzy (SynapseHub) · Regulatory Compliance and Protection
legal.t_sub: Last updated: October 2026. By using Hubzy, you accept the following terms:
legal.t1_p: Hubzy is a gamification and micro-learning web environment for students. It turns notes and documents into interactive circuits of questions and concept cards to reinforce knowledge in a friendly, stress-free way.
legal.t2_p: Your notes, slides and texts remain 100% yours. Hubzy does not sell, commercialize or claim copyright over the academic material you upload to your personal account.
legal.t3_p: The user agrees not to upload illegal content, malicious software or protected material they are not authorized to use for personal study purposes.
legal.p_sub: Your privacy is fundamental. We comply with data protection standards (GDPR / CCPA):
legal.p1_p: We only collect the data strictly necessary for your study experience: name or nickname, email for sign-in, and optional voice preferences for Hubzi.
legal.p2_p: Under no circumstances do we sell or share your personal data or documents with advertisers or external entities.
legal.p3_p: Your study folders are isolated by your user ID in databases protected with encryption at rest and in transit (HTTPS / TLS).
legal.r_sub: Full transparency on transactions processed via Stripe:
legal.r1_p: Unlimited access to analysis of long documents, multimodal OCR, advanced game modes and Hubzi's personalized voice.
legal.r2_p: You can cancel your subscription anytime from your profile or the Stripe portal. No forced contracts or penalties. You keep access until the end of the billed period.
legal.r3_p: If during the first 7 days you experience any technical failure or the service doesn't meet your expectations, contact support for a 100% refund.
legal.c_sub: We use only essential local storage (`localStorage`) and technical cookies:
legal.c1_p: To keep you securely signed in without asking for login on every screen.
legal.c2_p: To quickly remember your volume preferences, chosen avatar and study progress.
legal.c3_p: We don't share or sell your activity to ad networks.

nlp.stress: Hey, hey! I'm here, your buddy Hubzi. Breathe with me for a second: what you're feeling is completely normal and valid. Even the brightest get stuck. Shall we take a Zen pause and then tackle it together with full energy?
nlp.greet: Hiiii {{name}}! So happy to hear your voice! Tell me, how can I help you today?
nlp.happy: YESSS! That's exactly what I wanted to hear! You make me super happy! I knew you'd do it, I always knew!
nlp.define_m: Great question! Let me tell you about "{{label}}": {{hint}}. Does that help?
nlp.define_k: it's a key concept of today's topic
nlp.define_g: I love that you ask! Today's topic is "{{title}}". Look closely at each node's questions, the keys are there. Trust yourself!
nlp.hint_m: Here's your hint! For "{{label}}": {{hint}}. {{cards}} You can do it, I know!
nlp.hint_k: look for the card whose main function matches
nlp.hint_done: You almost have it all! Look at the remaining cards and trust your first instinct. You're absolutely amazing!
nlp.fb_open: I heard you say "{{text}}"! I love chatting with you. I suggest focusing on "{{label}}". I believe in you!
nlp.fb_done: You said "{{text}}" and I love hearing from you! You're a study champion, no doubt!

speech.invite_1: I'm all ears! Ask me anything, I'm here for you 💙
speech.invite_2: Talk to me! I love hearing you 🎙️
speech.invite_3: I'm listening carefully! What do you need, champ?
speech.invite_4: So glad you're talking to me! Tell me what you need 🎙️
speech.no_support: Aw, I'm dying to hear you! But it seems your browser doesn't support the microphone. Try Chrome or Edge and I'll be waiting 🥹
speech.no_https: Your mic only works on a secure connection (HTTPS) or localhost. Open me from a secure URL and I'll be back to listen 🔒
speech.denied: Don't leave me without hearing you! Enable the microphone in the browser lock/permissions and I'll fly back 🙏
speech.no_device: I can't find any microphone on your device. Plug one in or check its settings and let's try 🎙️
speech.busy: Another program is using your microphone right now. Close it (video calls, recorders) and I'll talk to you instantly 🎧
speech.no_access: I can't access your microphone on this device. Check system permissions and I'll try again 🥹
speech.denied2: Don't leave me without hearing you! Enable the microphone in your browser/system permissions and I'll be back to listen 🙏
speech.no_speech: Almost heard you! I didn't catch your words. Can you try again? 💙
speech.capture: I can't read your microphone — it seems busy with another app or disconnected. Check the device and I'll be back 🎙️
speech.network: Your browser's voice service isn't responding (it usually needs internet). Check your connection and try again 🌐
speech.mic_fail: I want to hear you so much! But something failed with the microphone. Check permissions and I'll fly back 🥹
